audit_reason: CRA states that 1Q24 results improved through the firm's own cost-reduction efforts. OE semantics are valid, but the cited passage is evidence of a current/realized effort rather than a clearly prospective action after the report date. Preserve OE descriptively, exclude from strict prospective benchmark.

Latest CRA attributes historical financial improvement to working-capital management and settlement of construction receivables, but also notes receivables increased in 2024. No sufficiently specific prospective receivables/inventory action is stated. Preserve WC1 as descriptive mapping, exclude from strict.

CRA states that debt was reduced in 2023 using stronger operating cash flow and forecasts gradual easing of debt burden before expansion. It does not state a prospective principal-repayment/deleveraging policy after the report date. Preserve DL descriptively, exclude from strict.

Primary report observes lower selling commission from reduced home-shopping mix and expects manufacturing-cost savings from acquisition of Rebom Cosmetics. The prospective cost effect is tied to a material acquisition and production-facility integration; strict one-action OE would suppress the noncanonical co-action.

Primary report explains lower fixed-cost share, scale-up/productivity improvements and cost reduction that had already driven four consecutive profitable quarters. A later July report says efficiency effects continue but only a secondary automated summary was recovered. Preserve OE descriptively; strict prospective mapping remains unproven.
